title: TosheLabs Pipeline ticket — schema v1
description: Contract for tickets the TosheLabs Pipeline will accept. See TICKET-SCHEMA.md for prose. Producers (operator, LLMs, scripts) are responsible for emitting conformant tickets; the pipeline rejects non-conforming tickets with field-level reasons.

id.description: Unique within the backlog file. Examples: BUG-261, T-359, BUG-261A, PIPE-001.

schema_version.description: Schema version this ticket conforms to. Pipeline rejects unsupported versions.

status.description: Closed set of five values. Concepts like 'deferred', 'subsumed', 'moot', 'decided' live as fields on done tickets, not as separate statuses.

priority.description: P0 = production breakage, drop everything. P1 = important, this sprint. P2 = nice-to-have. P3 = backlog/monitor.

complexity.description: trivial = single file, no logic. small = 1-3 files. medium = up to ~10 files. large = >10 files OR architectural shift; pipeline may refuse to plan in one shot.

order.description: Optional explicit ordering for the actionable queue.
